purpose: Fixed internal functional test snapshot of the current engine, stored field and read/write rules

package_versions.identity_note: Use source_commit; package versions alone do not identify this engine

lab.relation_to_live_core: Opt-in research executors; not used by the frozen field Core/Access recall or placement geometry

quantized.rounding_contract: existing per-operation fixed-precision nonlinear recurrence; affine-only path retains exact integer kernel
quantized.unit_status: current world-intermediate unit; general local-unit and canonical-anchor normalization not implemented

user_selected_next_configuration.canonical_anchor: physical source cell or fixed geometric block, independent of representation reanchor

read_write_rules.entry: one Host-selected physical entry per encounter
read_write_rules.focus: actual displayed adjacent coverage_down target; ascend uses actual focus_path
read_write_rules.writes: NEW/REUSE/revision_current/MOVE keep existing Core/Access semantics; evidence and history remain readable
read_write_rules.placement_readback: a displayed writable candidate does not by itself prove downward reachability; verify the intended reading path
read_write_rules.reorganization: read back new and relevant old routes; zero global orphans alone is insufficient
read_write_rules.maintenance: follow observed paths and top-down inspection; optional on-demand inverse-down; no required persistent parent index
read_write_rules.first_surface: complete short statements stored in upper physical cells; details unfold below

precision_reproduction_inputs.twist_depth_meaning: number of twist segments within one adjacent layer pair, not physical layers crossed

tests.scope: focused functional regression and actual frozen-field replay; no new semantic superiority or large-capacity claim

future_comparison: Keep this source commit, field and parameter set fixed; identify candidate revision and changed configuration explicitly in each comparison
